hero.alt: RH-01, a faceted black armoured humanoid robot with a glowing visor, in the dark HUE RoboHub lab while students work at their stations behind it.

track_embedded.alt: Macro view of an ESP32 development board on an ESD mat, jumper wires running to a breadboard, with STM32, Arduino-class and motor-driver boards, sensors and an oscilloscope glowing in the dark lab.

team_line_follower.alt: The Line Follower team's low, lightweight robot tracking a white line on a black epoxy floor, lit with electric-blue rim light.

team_sumo.alt: Two sumo robots facing off inside a black dohyo ring with a white border, red rim light glinting on the steel blade.

team_sprint.alt: The Sprint team's long, low racer on its starting grid between white lane lines, orange rim light tracing the bodywork.

team_autonomous.alt: The Autonomous team's rover on a mapped test floor, its LiDAR sweeping green scan lines through the haze.

team_innovation.alt: The Innovation team's prototype on a glowing violet-rimmed plinth, presented like a product reveal.

track_robotics.alt: A six-wheel rocker-bogie research rover with a stereo camera mast and LiDAR on a gridded motion-test floor, its planned trajectory glowing ahead.

track_mechanical.alt: An exploded gearbox floating above the workbench — machined flange, bearing, brass spur gear, pinion and a printed cap — with amber explode guides.

track_software.alt: An autonomous rover inside its own LiDAR point cloud: scanned walls in mint-green points, an occupancy grid on the floor and a planned path to the goal.

arena.alt: The RoboHub competition arena: two sumo robots facing off in a black dohyo, the line-follower course and sprint lanes beyond, LED walls and light beams overhead.

bootcamp_1.alt: Bootcamp week 1: the RH-T1 trainer robot's chassis plate on a bench stand, battery holder and breadboard being installed.

bootcamp_2.alt: Bootcamp week 2: a microcontroller board, IR line sensors and an ultrasonic sensor added to the RH-T1 chassis.

bootcamp_3.alt: Bootcamp week 3: gear motors, wheels, caster and the motor driver being fitted to RH-T1.

bootcamp_4.alt: Bootcamp week 4: an ESP32 wireless module, antenna and status LEDs added to RH-T1.

bootcamp_5.alt: Bootcamp week 5: the 3D-printed body shell and front bumper lowered onto RH-T1.

bootcamp_6.alt: Bootcamp week 6: RH-T1 fully integrated with its wiring harness, LiPo battery and underglow.

bootcamp_7.alt: Challenge Day: the finished RH-T1 robot on the line course under gold light, a trophy in the background.

recruit.alt: RH-01's armoured robotic hand reaching toward the viewer, its palm core glowing blue.

recruit_tall.alt: RH-01's armoured robotic hand reaching toward the viewer, its palm core glowing blue (portrait).

trophy.alt: A gold RoboHub Challenge trophy on a black stone plinth engraved with the RH mark, lit by a shaft of light.

idea.alt: Blueprint: the rover and a robot arm drawn as glowing wireframes over a drafting grid with dimension lines.

showcase.alt: Three RoboHub machines — a rover, an innovation prototype with a robot arm and an autonomous platform — on lit plinths in a dark studio.

team_env.alt: The RoboHub lab at work: students at their stations, robot arms on the benches, BUILD · LEARN · COMPETE banners and RH-01 on its display stand.

macro.alt: Macro of an STM32 microcontroller and an aluminium heatsink on a dark PCB, lit by a raking blue light.

logo3d_wide.alt: The HUE RoboHub RH mark as a dark chrome sculpture with its glowing blue axis, reflected in a black mirror floor.

logo3d_square.alt: The HUE RoboHub RH mark as a dark chrome sculpture with its glowing blue axis (square).
